Welcome to Riftbound Basics featuring runes. In the Riftbound TCG, your energy to play cards comes automatically. Each player brings their own rune deck consisting of 12 cards. This consists of runes in the domains of your legend. A Draven deck, for example, can play chaos and fury runes. At the start of your turn, immediately after you have readied all your cards and received points for holding a battlefield, you may play the top two cards from your rune deck. You need runes to pay the energy and power costs on your cards. For example, for Victor Leader, you must pay four energy, which means exhausting four runes of any color and then pay a power cost. You do this by placing a rune of the color shown under the energy cost at the bottom of your rune deck. This process is also called recycling. Some cards such as seal of insight have no energy cost but do have a power cost. However, to ensure your energy isn't lost, you may float the energy. That is, exhaust your runes, place them under your rune deck, and later use the energy gained to play another card.
